faf6.publisher: US Department of Transportation / Bureau of Transportation Statistics
faf6.mode_code: 1=truck, as defined by FAF data tabulation tool
faf6.value_unit: million constant 2022 USD of goods moved, NOT freight transportation charges
faf6.extraction: exact source rows with dms_mode=1,trade_type=1, state pairs (24,42),(42,24); no weighting or sample invention

eia.measurement: Retail on-highway diesel price including taxes; USD per gallon; not contract fuel-surcharge tariff

custody_notes: The full BTS source ZIP was directly downloaded through a public-web research browser and hashes were computed on 2026-10-17.
No private customer invoice, tariff agreement, actual carrier remittance, payment record, verified real savings or proprietary source was acquired.
The ZIP bytes are not uploaded to GitHub; a bounded extract, strong full-archive hash and local verification script allow independent replay.
If the publisher changes the archive, quarantine until an authorized new-vintage evidence review; never silently treat a revision as comparable.
